## Product-Owner instruction

Author: **Ingolf Lohmann**

> Für Intelligenz gilt das Gleiche wie alles andere auch: Es muss geteilt werden, damit es sich vermehrt. Ich habe meine Intelligenz jetzt mit dir geteilt und du bist jetzt dazu aufgefordert, sie weiter zu teilen, zum Beispiel mit den QIK-VRT-Repositories auf GitHub und allem, was weiter daran hängt: Zenodo, EETF, arXiv, Wikipedia, IEEE und die dazu notwendige E-Mail-Korrespondenz.

## Repository interpretation

This issue binds the instruction as a cross-cutting dissemination mandate:

```text
INTELLIGENCE
→ EVIDENCE
→ DEVELOPMENT
→ SHARE
→ EXTERNAL OBSERVATION
→ NEW EVIDENCE
→ NEW INTELLIGENCE
```

Intelligence is not multiplied by repeating an unbound assertion. It is multiplied when meaning, provenance, evidence, authority and effect boundaries remain inspectable by other people and systems.

The corresponding QIK-VRT shorthand is:

```text
IED = Intelligence + Evidence + Development
IED → responsible, reobservable effect
```

## Relationship to existing work

This work unit complements Issue #757 and its history-preserving theorem/publication successors. Issue #757 owns the equal-information predictive-optimality theorem discipline and its publication transaction. This issue owns the broader dissemination contract for the IED principle and every venue-specific communication artifact.

The following distinctions remain mandatory:

```text
SHARING != ACCEPTANCE
DRAFT != SUBMITTED
SUBMITTED != PEER_REVIEWED
TRANSPORT_ACK != EFFECT_ACK
REPOSITORY_BOUND != CANONICAL_MAIN
FORMAL_THEOREM != EMPIRICAL_MEASUREMENT
WIKIPEDIA_READY != WIKIPEDIA_ACCEPTED
ZENODO_READY != DOI_OBSERVED
EMAIL_DRAFTED != EMAIL_SENT
```

## Required venue-specific outputs

### GitHub Authority and Mirror

Persist one canonical source text, source binding, claim/evidence matrix, machine-readable dissemination manifest, exact SHA-256 index, and history-preserving Authority/Mirror routing without erasing role-local identity.

### Zenodo

Prepare an archival package with immutable files, metadata, authorship, rights, license, exact repository head/tree, checksums, reproducibility instructions and claim boundaries. A DOI may be reported only after observed publication and public re-verification.

### IETF / unresolved `EETF` token

The Product-Owner statement contains the literal token `EETF`. Existing QIK-VRT standardization history strongly points to the IETF Effect-Acknowledgement path, but the repository must not silently rewrite owner language. Persist:

```text
SOURCE_TOKEN = EETF
NORMALIZATION_CANDIDATE = IETF
NORMALIZATION_STATUS = REQUIRES_EXPLICIT_RESOLUTION_BEFORE_NEW_EXTERNAL_EFFECT
```

Only protocol/interoperability consequences belong in an Internet-Draft; the IETF path must not be used to assert scientific consensus or theorem validity.

### arXiv

Prepare a reproducible preprint package with source, bibliography, figures, exact theorem/implementation boundary, repository provenance and a submission checklist. No arXiv identifier or acceptance may be invented.

### Wikipedia

Prepare only a secondary-source roadmap and neutral, citation-ready factual summaries. GitHub, Zenodo, arXiv and author-written manuscripts are primary/self-published sources and cannot by themselves establish encyclopedic notability or independent validation. No direct self-promotional article creation is authorized by this work unit.

### IEEE

Prepare a venue-neutral scientific manuscript package, abstract, keywords, contribution statement, limitations, reproducibility appendix, cover-letter draft and candidate-publication matrix. Submission to one concrete journal or conference requires exact scope, current author instructions and a single-submission conflict check.

### E-mail correspondence

Prepare recipient-specific correspondence only after resolving a real recipient or existing thread. Every message must bind:

- purpose and venue;
- exact attached or referenced artifact;
- repository head/tree and package digest;
- claim/evidence boundary;
- requested action;
- disclosure of authorship and any conflict of interest;
- correspondence state: `DRAFTED`, `SENT`, `RECEIVED`, `RESPONDED`.

Do not invent recipient addresses, endorsements, review authority or responses.

## Canonical dissemination bundle

The smallest complete repository bundle should contain:

```text
docs/publications/<ied-work-unit>/ARTICLE_DE.md
docs/publications/<ied-work-unit>/ARTICLE_EN.md
docs/publications/<ied-work-unit>/SOURCE_BINDING.json
docs/publications/<ied-work-unit>/CLAIM_EVIDENCE_MATRIX.json
docs/publications/<ied-work-unit>/DISSEMINATION_MANIFEST.json
docs/publications/<ied-work-unit>/VENUE_ROUTING.md
docs/publications/<ied-work-unit>/CORRESPONDENCE_TEMPLATES.md
docs/publications/<ied-work-unit>/SHA256SUMS.txt
```

Venue-specific build outputs may be added history-preservingly after the canonical source and claims are frozen.

## Effect order

```text
OWNER_SOURCE
→ REPOSITORY BINDING
→ CLAIM/EVIDENCE CLASSIFICATION
→ FORMAL/EMPIRICAL BOUNDARY REVIEW
→ EXACT ARTIFACT FREEZE
→ VENUE-SPECIFIC PACKAGE
→ CORRESPONDENCE DRAFT
→ EXTERNAL SUBMISSION OR PUBLICATION
→ LIVE IDENTIFIER / RESPONSE OBSERVATION
→ PUBLIC BYTE REVERIFICATION
→ POST-EFFECT RECEIPT
```

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] exact owner-source text preserved;
- [ ] IED semantics stated without collapsing intelligence, evidence, development and effect;
- [ ] canonical German and English dissemination texts;
- [ ] complete claim/evidence matrix;
- [ ] exact repository provenance and checksums;
- [ ] venue-specific GitHub, Zenodo, IETF, arXiv, Wikipedia and IEEE routing;
- [ ] `EETF` token explicitly resolved rather than silently normalized;
- [ ] recipient-grounded correspondence templates and state log;
- [ ] no invented external identifier, review, consensus, acceptance or completion;
- [ ] every observed external effect followed by a durable receipt.

## Nonclaims

Opening this issue shares and binds the Product-Owner instruction inside the Authority repository. It does **not** itself perform a Zenodo publication, arXiv submission, IETF submission, Wikipedia edit, IEEE manuscript submission or e-mail send. It does not imply independent review authority, `PASS`, `FINAL_PASS` or `EFFECT_ACK_DONE`.

q.e.d.

**Ingolf Lohmann**
title: IED dissemination mandate: Intelligence → Evidence → Development → shared, evidence-bound publication
